countries.name: San Marino
countries.summary: Legal, geopolitical and compliance advice for companies, organisations and professionals operating in Italy–San Marino and EU–San Marino relations.
countries.html:
Legal, geopolitical and compliance advice

Operating in the Republic of San Marino with method, confidentiality and a cross-border vision.

We assist companies, organisations and professionals dealing with the Republic of San Marino, combining law, geopolitics, compliance and risk management in Italy–San Marino and EU–San Marino relations.

Why San Marino requires a dedicated approach

San Marino is a sovereign legal system with its own rules and strong operational integration with Italy: close bilateral relations, daily economic and professional flows, constantly evolving AML/CFT standards, and a high level of attention to reputation and transparency. What makes the difference is a clear scope, well-designed contracts and rigorous due diligence.

What we do

  • Contracts and procurement (supplies, services, ICT, culture/events, facility).
  • AML/CFT and anti-corruption compliance; reputational due diligence on partners and supply chains.
  • Company & commercial: cross-border transactions, partnerships, distribution, joint projects.
  • Data, Cyber & Digital Law (privacy in Italy–San Marino/EU data flows, cybersecurity, incident response).
  • IP & Media: trademarks, copyright, licensing, image rights and editorial content.
  • Litigation and ADR: governing law and jurisdiction clauses, risk prevention strategies.
  • Executive training for legal, compliance and operations teams.

Who we work with

  • Companies (manufacturing, services, ICT/cyber, publishing/media, events, tourism).
  • Cultural institutions and foundations, professional service providers.
  • Professional firms requiring specialised expertise on San Marino.

How we work

  • Defining the scope (objectives, stakeholders, timelines).
  • Intelligence and due diligence (integrity, supply chain compliance, country risks).
  • Legal design (contracts, policies, technical and organisational measures).
  • Confidential execution with document governance and accountability.
  • Monitoring of risk KPIs and regulatory and operational updates.

Benefits for the client

  • Reduced reputational and regulatory risk.
  • Clear and defensible contracts in cross-border relations.
  • Operational continuity in projects and supplies.
  • A single point of contact for legal, strategic and security matters.

Typical use cases

  • Supply of services and goods with cross-border clauses and AML/CFT requirements.
  • ICT and cyber hardening projects for San Marino operators or Italian operators with a presence in San Marino.
  • Media, cultural and event initiatives, including management of rights, permits and insurance.
  • Commercial and distribution partnerships between Italian and San Marino operators.
  • Supplier onboarding with due diligence and integrity clauses.

Contact us

AC Law Firm – Antonio Circosta, Attorney at Law. Request a confidential consultation: preliminary assessment, roadmap and quote.
